verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents an API versioning practice: a new endpoint version ships whenever a backwards-incompatible change is released. Versioned endpoints appear in the reference (e.g. v2 audit, v3 transaction process), and a 308 Permanent Redirect is used on one lookup endpoint. However, nothing in the pack describes a deprecation policy such as notice periods, sunset timelines or deprecation headers, which is half of the story. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy with timelines, deprecation signaling in API responses, and independent corroboration of version stability.
